about: Sections of a comparison, in the order they appear. The report script knows each id; you may change the order and the titles, but every id must appear exactly once.

sections.title: Features side by side
sections.purpose: For each feature: the competitor's status (yes, no or partial) with the fetched page that shows it, and yours with the file that shows it or 'you said'.

sections.title: Overlapping jobs
sections.purpose: Which of the competitor's jobs your product also does: full, partial or none.

sections.title: Openings for you
sections.purpose: The competitor's gaps that are openings for you, citing the brief's rows (G1, F2, ...) or fetched pages.

sections.title: Pricing
sections.purpose: The competitor's pricing from the fetched pages, and yours from your files or your answer.

sections.title: Positioning options
sections.purpose: Two or three one-line positioning statements for your product.

sections.title: Risks
sections.purpose: Where the competitor could hurt you, citing the brief's rows or fetched pages.

sections.title: Recommended next steps
sections.purpose: Advice only. Nothing here is done for you.

sections.title: Your side
sections.purpose: Facts about your product, each citing a file in your repository or 'you said'. A cite that cannot be checked is labelled unverified.

sections.title: Not answered
sections.purpose: Questions you skipped. Nothing in the report fills them in.

sections.title: Sources
sections.purpose: The brief's date, the fetched pages this comparison cites, unverified cites, dropped rows and ignored cites.
